review:
We have been using app for a long time and more and more often one problem appears. Becoming almost “normal”that request is accepted, estimating waiting time is 4 minutes and suddenly after few minutes of waiting it become even more (eg. 5) then you waiting a few more, and more… to see that:
 1. driver has CANCELED on your trip. This should not be allowed. How they can cancel on client? This is already well known issue and people start to believe they cannot rely on UBER. Can you please do something about it. 
2. It’s also very unethical practice that after cancelling when you search again trip is becoming more and more expensive! (I assume system is estimating based on demand and you are creating demand on your own searching many times. This isn’t right. Will give your competitors full rights to win the battle. 
3. Destination is not the same as stop. Destination by default is where you will end your journey, stop (that is drop off) is tweet you supposed to stop on your way to your destination! App is not working like that(I was recently told when driver went around, didn’t drop the passenger on his way. Fix your all. It should work out what is the best way to go (and where to stop) to not pay double. It’s using gps, is not hard. Also those names are misleading if destination is understand by you (app!) as a first stop.  This not what “destination” is.

It all started on a chilly Autumn evening, my friend and I had been waiting for various other taxis that we had booked with local taxi firms, but to no avail. The rest of the group had left for the club, leaving Dan and myself to fend for ourselves. As the night grew longer, and our beer jackets began to loosen, we needed a hero. Dan took the initiative and got on to the App Store. Who could we trust with the simple job of getting us from A to B? Uber, and more specifically (spoiler alert), Muhammad. Within three and a half minutes, Dan got a call, and Muhammad had arrived. We placed down our half full (half empty?) beers and entered the vehicle. Muhammad stopped us right there and insisted we grabbed the beers and took them with us, he wanted us to have a good night, almost as much as we did. A journey full of anecdotes and laughs lasted for approximately ten to twelve minutes, and I was honestly sad to see the lights of the club in the horizon. Muhammad was a joy to be around, a free spirit, and without him, Dan and I would have been stranded on the streets of Leeds, for what could have been the rest of our lives. Uber isn't just a taxi service and this isn't just an app. Muhammad was a soldier of the night, and Uber was his General. I will never forget the 26th September 2015, thank you Uber, take care x

Mohammed picked me up at around 4 this morning from A&E’s entrance where I’d spent a gruelling 12 hours being grilled by dr’s, assessment nurses, psychiatrists and procured my prescription of choice. Filled with Nottingham’s sick, ill and dying, full of fear, waiting patiently and finally walking  out to a foul January morning wondering still if they’d got it right, it needed a certain calibre of man who knew when it was right to speak and more importantly, when. I was in no mood for idle chit chat. From the off, the Uber app just works. I love it. The AandE receptionist’s kindly showed me the brilliant impacting immediate messaging service pin pointing the EXACT location and EXACT time of arrival. From the off, it was only 2 mins, a choice of vehicles - and amazingly cheap considering I live 5 miles away, it’s the only thing around in the middle of the night - I easily could expect a way higher fee - helps to random my exhaustion, fear, and simply just needing to be home for under a tenner is simply fantastic. I’m aware of Uber’s competition and in the past, I’ve actually had accounts with them - but something changed and I no longer used DG, only something I’ve always worked for many years, which is Uber. If I could give Uber 100 seats, I would. Fantastic company.

Felt really sick after work on Thursday at around 4pm so I ordered an uber to take me home instead of getting the train, I was given a price of £16 and a waiting time of 7 minutes so I ordered the uber. AFTER I had paid, the waiting time then changed to ‘longer wait’ but I wasn’t to bothered about waiting another 5 minutes, it then changed again to ‘trying to find you a driver.’ After around 10 minutes of waiting uber completely cancelled my order without giving me any notification, I only realised because I went on to the app to see if there was any updates on where my uber was. I was mad they had cancelled my first uber but I still needed to get home and the train I could’ve gotten on had passed by now while I was waiting for my uber, so I went on to order another uber only to see they had DOUBLED the price for the same journey. The price was originally £16 and they had put it up to £32, for the exact same journey and the apparent reasoning for this was because the area was busy. Now I understand an extra £5 if it’s busy, but to CANCEL my original order for no reason and then DOUBLE the price is absolutely ridiculous and money grabbing. I then had to wait for my money to be refunded from the first order and ended up having to wait 30 minutes for the train because I refuse to pay £32 for a £16 journey. I do not recommend uber and won’t be using it again, just book a taxi. Uber is not reliable and clearly changes their prices whenever they feel like it.

So we’ve been using Uber a couple of times a day whilst on holiday in the US. Literally every single time the estimated car arrival time is out by a great deal. Just now when confirming a trip, we did so based on the 4 minute away estimation of the nearest car. We waited outside our hotel for more like 14 minutes before the car actually got there. First the time went up to 5 minutes then to 7 minutes, then it just stayed 6 minutes for a few minutes and slowly started going back down again (not in a real-time minute counter but Uber’s much slower minute counter). There wasn’t really much traffic on the street so I don’t understand how can the estimation be out by this much. I would much prefer to know the actual estimated arrival time as opposed to standing by the road like an idiot. I definitely would have dried my hair this morning if I knew about the extra 10 minutes wait time, instead I was standing on the windy roadside for quarter of an hour with my wet hair. And this was pretty much the same with each ride ordered I’ve the past 10 days. Anywhere between double to triple the amount of estimated car arrival time we had to wait, not cool. Please make your app more accurate. For now I’m going to switch to Lyft for the last 4 days if our trip and see if they do a better estimation job. It’s just a shame as otherwise Uber would be a service I’d use and recommend more...

I don’t think I’ve ever had such a disappointing experience with taxi‘s as I had with Uber, quite astonishing how many times people (me included) make a report because someone cancelled the trip and I still had to pay, or the times when a driver would make inappropriate comments making me feel unsafe and guess what! If you cancel, they will get their money and their behaviour is excused. In general I have also met some with an audacity to be rude to someone that is just minding their own business and not making any issues, just tired on the way back home from a long shift, feels like they take advantage on those occasions and know they will get away with it with money still in their pocket. I even had someone get in my Uber and drive off on it when I finished work late night, only to arrive and realise my ride was already near my home. 

Recently found out that there is Uber Pets and they charge double the price! Not only, someone I know was on the phone to me recently whilst waiting for one and the trip got cancelled twice (they would arrive close to the destination and simply not take the trip), making them extremely late to a vet appointment, making them reschedule the appointment and they were still charged for the cancelled trips. Waste of time is my point. Support your local taxi businesses people, they aren’t money hungry corporate companies that are more than willing to accommodate in various situations.

Uber has a terrible cancel culture. How and why is it a norm that a professional service can accept a transaction and then just cancel when they want? It’s outrageous and I don’t think the public have to put up with it anymore. If a person is waiting and trusting that a service will deliver at 1am after waiting for 10-15 minutes for it to be accepted, the last thing they should expect is to then be cancelled on. If an Uber driver has accepted a trip, which includes accepting the price and the director, they SHOULD NOT be allowed to cancel. If they do, they get fined £5 and it goes to the person they cancelled on. It’s unacceptable. Uber drivers just cancel over and over and over again. I’m tired of it, and I’m not accepting it anymore. Imagine sitting on a plane to fly somewhere and the pilot says “No, don’t fancy it”. So, after many years with Uber, today I am deleting my account. Prices are so high anyways, it cost me the same amount to get home last Saturday (£50 for a 22 mins journey) as it would have if I got a black cab in London. So my business is going back to those boys.

THIS HAPPENS TOO MANY TIMES! The last time I left Uber, it was for a whole year if not more. It’s not fair that when a driver can’t find you, or when a driver is late and you can’t wait anymore because you are standing in the rain and have to go, or Uber suddenly finds a driver 15-20mins later when you are already at your destination ( I could go on), that you cannot cancel a trip without being charged! Last time, my driver got lost and I was on the phone to him giving him directions, standing in heavy rain after I had to walk back to the pick up point, he got so rude and cancelled the trip and I’m the one that got charged! Today, Uber suddenly found a cab after I had already walked half way home in the rain! The. The driver couldn’t find me. When I was finally on this trip and got home, I was charged almost £10 for a less than 5minute drive without traffic! How is this fair? Besides being able to see, i know this because driving hone from work use to take me 5mins! 
There has to be a way that everyone is held accountable for their own end of the problem. Do drivers get charged when they cancel? Because they do, a lot. I am so disappointed and so angry that I am very much considering going back to normal cabs. I have no patience for unfair systems and I believe I have been overcharged or charged for a service not used too many times!

I agree with the review I just read - pick up times are a major problem. They are inaccurate. Also, sometimes I want the fastest pick up time possible and when I type in my ride details, some driver 15m away accepts the job and I have to cancel and restart so I can hopefully find someone quicker and the same driver keeps rebooking the job which is completely annoying. There needs to be some mechanism where you can say why you’re cancelling the job - ie. wait time too long - to invite the possibility of anyone else accepting the job or being open to a new, quicker pick up time when another driver is finishing a trip locally or just starting their shift, to be able to pick up the job. Some way of indicating that you’re in a rush would be good !!! Tonight I was in a rush and had to wait 25 minutes for an Uber, from a central London location, where I am sure more Ubers were driving past, but once someone accepts my ride I am locked in. And they were finishing a trip and dropping someone off still. I don’t want to have to wait for that driver, I definitely want to be open to a quicker pick up. 
And the time was given as, for example, 5 minutes , and the 5 doesn’t go down for 15 minutes and then the 4 lasts for 3 minutes etc. Can you review this aspect ? Thanks. Otherwise great.

I'm currently in Vietnam for a few months and was advised to get uber or grab taxi for local transport, I thought uber being the most familiar that I would use it. In practice the app for me is terrible, it asks repeatedly for me to verify my phone number and once the app is open the page to verify my phone number never appears, plus it rejects my card method of payment. Customer services say this is my bank not authorising international transactions but grab taxi works just fine, and also has the option to pay a certain amount of money in exchange for credits so your rides are already paid for in one go until you top your credits up again. So it's not my bank that's the problem, it's uber. Everyone around me, at least, finds uber frustrating and expensive compared to fares on grab taxi which I only learned existed a few days ago, but is far better than uber and does exactly the same thing just in a more efficient and user friendly manner. My first ride with uber worked fine as I paid cash, but now it wants me to verify cards that I don't even want to pay with for security reasons and won't even accept the card details and simply says "invalid" (nothing more because that would be too useful...)  even if I wanted to use uber I can't, so if anyone has any issues I recommend grab, it's exactly the same service and works more smoothly (for me at least)

Please do not use, especially if you are on a budget or a bit strapped for cash, I have heard a few stories about this company, and now I believe them after my experience with Uber. I ordered a taxi on the app and waited for 45 minutes, no one came, and the money had been taken from my account, I spoke to the customer support on the phone and he was quite friendly and said the money would be in my account within a month, I still haven’t seen the money, I thought I would give them a second chance, so again I ordered a taxi on the app, I waited 25 minutes this time and decided to cancel it, which came with a cancellation fee, the control these drivers have over surrounding areas in terms of transport is immoral, I am sure they take advantage of the apps algorithm by multiple drivers saying they are not available in busy areas which then activates the system/app to charge much more than the standard prices due to demand. This company is clearly built on greed, I find it scary that technology allows these companies to fleece our wallets as easy as that. I usually don’t leave reviews in-fact I never have, but please please be aware, I have heard some positive stories, I think Uber seems to favour those who joined the app when it first started as their ratings will be marked as higher and they are a long term user, not a good time to join the app, get a taxi, much cheaper. Shambolic.

I have been using Uber for more than 7 years now and never had an issue before. But yesterday in York a driver left me after 12am alone and stranded just because I argued with him about the right pick up point, which should have been in the temporary car park beside the train station. There’s people waiting there for rides, many Uber cars entering and picking passengers there. The app says that the pick up point is there! This driver whose name I cannot remember responded to me in a very aggressive manner when I first argued with him that where he stopped was not the correct pick up point and he said that Ubers are not allowed to go inside the car park, which is clearly a lie, confirmed by the second driver which picked me after this incident. This is appalling customer service, the guy just left me there in the middle of the night, alone! Luckily that are is not dangerous and the other driver didn’t take much time to arrive but if I was in any other area which is safe, how this could be! I called Uber customer service to report what happened and they were not even decent to offer me a fair compensation for the stress I passed. Just says they would investigate the matter, but what they will do about it I won’t know likely. I deleted the app and not using it again! It’s a shame because it used to be very convenient and cheaper prices, but the standard of some drivers is shocking.

Uber is not what it used to be anymore after covid!  Now they have full of unprofessional drivers who: ( below are all my true experience! Why I gave up Uber completely now!) 1. Dropped you off in the middle of nowhere when there was a road block or traffic and they don’t want to waste time on you! 2. Refused to take you to the destination because you changed to a different address 5 minutes drive away from the original one! And the change was made before you got on the car! And you have to cancel to get charged 5 pounds! 3. Dropped you off to a tube station nearby and told you to go by tube and still charged you the same full amount!! 4 having a fierce fight over phone with their wives while driving and when you politely ask them to quiet down they got totally mad and unprofessional at you! 5. Arrived and wait for 30 second then cancelled right at your face! ( think they got a must better rate from another quote ) 6 stopped at 2 minutes walk away from the meeting point! And when asked specifically to come close they refused!!! When you are travelling with an injured friend you both had to walk to be able to get into the car! UBER has unfortunately took a 180 degree turn from being a top class client friendly app to a dodgy app full of trash drivers who probably lost their previous jobs as a homeless!

Extremely unreliable company. They take zero responsibility for their faults and do not care about their users. Drivers keep asking you to cancel and never show up. They’ll say they’re stuck in traffic even when there’s zero traffic. They wait for you to cancel and then you get charged. Even if you don’t get charged, you still lose time waiting for the driver to arrive when they have no intention showing up. The last time I used this app was for a ride that would take me to the train station for an international trip. The rider kept driving further away from the meet-up point and started asking me to cancel because he was “stuck in traffic” at 8 o’clock on a Sunday morning with ZERO traffic. Although I had requested the Uber well in advance, my partner and I lost so much time waiting that we had to literally run to the station because we couldn’t afford waiting for another ride and almost missed our train. The temperature was -7 Celsius and after arriving at the station I got symptoms of exercise induced asthma that lasted for days. I asked for a compensation for this horrible experience that ruined the start of my partner’s birthday and got nothing in return without any apology or explanation. Horrible app, horrible customer service-best to avoid. I’ve deleted the app as well as Uber eats. Never using again!

I used to love using this app but recently it has become shocking, first of all I get charged for trips I haven’t even made as the driver cancelled them? How is that ok to do, then when I ring up to resolve the fact they have not only took payment for this trip they then take it twice? I finally got this refunded after an hour of arguing over the phone to the customer service! a week or so after me and my partner decided to give them a try again however this was a BIG mistake the driver accepted the trip to them message us saying we’re too far? Why accept the trip to begin with and to top it all off he wanted us to cancel the trip!! Knowing fully well we would be charged for that, the driver then began to argue with us as we said we was not cancelling the trip as he knows it charges and that he should cancel it as he shouldn’t accept the trip in the first place. He began to then drive further away from where we was with shocking attitude! i began to try and ring the driver and all he did was hang up!! How can you as a massive company allow drivers like this? I have deleted all forms of this app and so has my partner as we are beyond shocked with the behaviour of some of the drivers within this company, I will not ever be using this app again and I will also be informing family and friends to not use them too, I’ll be sticking to the good old taxi company’s from now on.

So I’ve had good experiences with this app and also really bad one, the good ones are based on just normal service, get picked up get dropped off. But it’s the bad ones that shine stronger with this service. Reason for my review today is just overall being fed up with the way the app works. I live close to the city centre just a 10 min walk but on days that we have bags or days that it’s raining it’s nice to be able to click a button and have a taxi arrive. Tonight I waited 10 mins for the app to show me 15 different drivers that were between 1-10 mins away and each time it showed me how close they were, I could see the actual taxi but the trip got declined. After the £6 taken out of my account 15 mins later it told me it was now £8, and I went ahead and paid it but still the exact thing happened, all the taxis so close but none of them wanted to pick me up because the trip is so short. They are not taxi rank taxis that have to wait in a queue and lose their place for a trip that’s not worth it, they’re free roam taxis that were all in different areas. 
The part I don’t agree with on this app is that after the 10 time of the trip being declined there should be a must deliver option so they don’t let us down. I understand that it’s a short trip but come on, £8 for a 3 min drive why should we have to wait for that.

I live in London and it’s been a few months now (maybe even longer) that almost every single time I order Uber I get drivers cancelling for no reason, either right away or sometimes after a few minutes, this happens several times and it results with me having to wait 10-20 min to get picked up. My main reasons for ordering Uber is because I’m either running late for something, terrible weather condition or I’m just exhausted which having to wait that long to get in your taxi can be really frustrating. I don’t understand if we as clients get charged a fee why don’t drivers get some sort of repercussions for cancelling as well, or maybe fix the app so a client doesn’t get several cancellations in a row. Another issue that this causes is that sometimes when it’s busy you get a fee rate but then after your driver cancels and you try to rebook I realise there’s a surcharge or surcharge increases which is really unfair you get one estimate and they keep increasing because your drivers are cancelling, so not only do you have to wait but you’re also getting charged extra. 
I’ve been taking black cabs instead of Uber now and probably will continue to do so until those issues have been fixed.

The concept of not having to carry cash, updates re driver location and ability to see who your driver is and rate them is good.  The location of the taxi is disputable and has often stated taxi is 5 minutes away and I’m still waiting 15 minutes later.  Ordered a taxi to pick up from Birmingham Arcadian carpark.  Said taxi was 2 minutes away.  So walked from the restaurant to the location.  By the time I arrived it stated taxi was 5 minutes away. Then a notification flashed on my screen that £4.25 had been taken from my account for cancelling the taxi.  I DIDN'T CANCEL THE TAXI and was annoyed as you can imagine.   So I was not happy that a cancellation fee was incorrectly taken.  Went into the app to try and contact for a refund.  The only option for a refund was for the money to be stored in my Uber account towards my next trip.  I want the money back as it was taken when I didn’t cancel it.  I drive and don’t use Uber very often now so the fact the money was not refunded to my card annoyed the hell out of me.  I probably won’t use them again now.  Or no doubt if I do, the money they claim is in my account won’t be put towards the trip.  Sort it out UBER and charge accordingly.  No number / email to contact anyone so it’s hard to to sort out any problems you encounter.

We ordered this Uber pet to get a taxi home - my wife, my dog and I from my parents house after we’d had dinner and drinks. We were impressed with the booking on the app and waited outside the house. We followed the driver and watched him drive past the house. We then followed him on the app a little round the estate then about 5-10 min later he drove back past us - very slowly. We knew it was him as we had the number plate from the app notifications. In this time, I had tried to call our driver - Abdul 2x but there was no answer at all. We were really annoyed about this having been stood on the pavement watching him drive past twice! And trying to call with no answer. The app then said no drivers available , and then gave us a notification that another taxi would collect us 25 minutes later! A different driver. We decided to walk home as we’d get home in that time. We were so disappointed as this was our first time using the Uber pet service having been told it would be available in our area. It appeared very rude and unacceptable service and we won’t be using again as it appears extremely unreliable. We took a screenshot of the driver having driven past us initially, then a photograph of him driving past us for the second time, both with time stamps.

Abroad, Uber have linked to the company itTaxi to rely on for requested trips. This company has the worst online reviews of any company I have ever seen, full of reports of scams and even physical assaults. My personal experience involved a scam of 27 euros that Uber will absolutely not help me with, even after charging my card. Despite arranging the journey for you and charging you directly, Uber claim no responsibility.

I placed 3 phone calls to Uber and two messages via the help centre, and each time I was given no help. The man on the phone actually hung up on me, quoting “there is nothing further I can do so I will be ending this call”, similarly both messages in the help centre were given “we will stop replying to this chat since there is nothing further we can do”. How is that customer service at all? In no sense was I given any form of help, I was simply ignored. The advisors in the help centre all offer different forms of advise and no one is cooperative. One person says my details of the trip will be forwarded and the other team will help, the next person says they will not be forwarded, then again someone else says they have already been forwarded, then finally someone goes they have not been. What sort of customer training is this? Just beyond appalling.

I used to be a big fan of Uber but recently I’ve been cancelled on so many times - I had a very important 45 minute journey which I scheduled 24 hours in advance for 6am the next morning which Uber accepted. They cancelled on me at 5:58 saying they couldn’t fulfil it, 2 minutes before I was meant to leave. They also took a holding amount which was significant out of my account the second I scheduled it - they should only take it when a driver has picked you up, it’s ludicrous. I had to get a black cab which was not easy where I live but from now on I’ll be using the black cab app as at least they are reliable and have a real person you can speak with to ensure they’ll turn up. I’ve also been cancelled on for shorter trips late at night when trying to get home and having to wait outside alone as a girl while being cancelled on multiple times is just dangerous. I’ve had this problem for years now and won’t be using Uber again.

I use Uber since the beginning. What once was an outstanding service, became a nightmare the last times I had to use. 2 times drivers kept saying to go to a “pick up point” and refused to say where was the location. After 3 minutes, cancelled the ride to collect fee and get another passenger. The last one did that to me 2 days ago in Stratford at 1 in the morning. After working 17 hours, he put the phone down on me and refused to answer the phone again. His instructions to this pick up point was “left hand side”. Of What, genius???? 
And the worse one was in September. I pre-ordered a big car to take me to my WEDDING (emergency drive as the car that was going to take me broke the night before, bad luck). The guy called me and said he was at my door. I told him I was going out and the he was taking me to my wedding. My photographer and bridesmaid spoke with the guy outside and asked him to wait 5 minutes. The guy simply cancelled the ride as I was coming out of my house. My bridesmaid order another one and guess what, the same guy showed up. Town hall almost cancelled my wedding because of this delay. 
The other one was that my mother forgot her glasses and Uber didn’t even tried to give it back. Costumer support inexistent, no phone, no email, no reply.

The app is generally good, but there seem to be 2 problems. 
The worst of these is that very often a driver seems to be allowed to accept a job whilst on the way somewhere else - and somewhere further away, not on the way towards me. And even though UBER knows this, they keep it a secret from us users so we don’t have the necessary info to decide whether to accept this situation.  Let me clarify. I open the app and I see drivers very close, presumably they are available, right, or why else show me. The driver that accepts might be 3 minutes away, but then he is 4 minutes away, and then I watch as he drives further and further away. The point is that now if I cancel, I will get charged! This cannot be the best way to do this! If UBER had told me that this driver has not made his drop off yet, I could have chosen whether to accept or not. But they don’t seem to like me choosing. 
Also, the pickup points are always at least 20-30 metres away from where I am, but sometimes more, so when I try to change the pickup point, it tells me that it is outside the area! And I have not taken a single step since switching on the app! So do I cancel? Or do I walk?

Booking a car is easy enough but the overall experience not so much. There is no way to contact the driver. The pricing structure lacks transparency and seems to be based on how much battery you have left on your phone and your handset make. Why give me a price range? I want a fixed price. Otherwise, I might as well book a mini cab or a normal taxi and not giving Uber a carte blanche charging me whatever they want.

Arriving at Manchester Terminal 2, the app told us to go to the short term parking on level 3. There is a level C but no level 3. The confusion led us to go back to the ground floor and asking staff before returning to level C. 

Looking at the app map animation, I could see the driver driving around and around although, I was not able to contact him. The driver claimed he tried to contact me although my phone never rang. He apologetically explained that he had just dropped somebody off at the usual drop off point which was further down the road when he accepted our trip but claimed he struggled to find us. To pick up passengers from the short term parking, he had to pay £4 on leaving. This extra cost was understandably but annoyingly then added to our bill. Why could the app not inform me that I would save money by walking 50 meters and be picked up outside the parking house?

I really wanted to like this app. I downloaded it on my Holidays (Spain). I booked the taxi to take us to Marbella. For what ever reason the taxi driver went the wrong way, even though the pick up point was clearly displayed. Next thing the taxi was cancelled.I booked another taxi and the same driver picked me up ten minutes later. The price quoted was £13. I clarified this with the driver to which he agreed. When I arrived at my destination I paid him cash, like you do with any other taxi, I even tipped him and gave him a good review. One hour later I received an email saying that 23 euro(20 euro fair plus 3 euros cancellation charge)had been deducted from my PayPal account. So what was a 13 euro fair turned into a 33 euro 5.6KM trip. It was probably my fault, but why is the app a mine field of hidden charges. Why did the driver lead me to believe I should pay by cash! I seriously felt like I’d been mugged. I sent a query and no one has gotten back to me. And to top it off the euro to GBP is lousy. I caught a bus back. Total fair 1 Euro 95 c. I’ll be deleted the app. Shame really it could have such potential.

Update: Uber have refunded me the fair. So I can’t really complain. I will give them another try:)

I tried signing up to Uber, keeping in mind that I have never had an account with them, to find my details blocked from the app, Uber, which I though was very strange to find out my information was being used for an account I didn’t not know about or used. After contacting Uber’s help service via email, they responded in a different language asking me to translate my email into their language. Following that, I then asked for my information to be unlinked from the account that was in use (obviously for safety reasons) which took a total of 6 days. Then my number seemed to be blocked from Uber too, which I also had to ask to be unblocked so I could sign up to Uber, which took a total of four days. After unlinking and unblocking my details and information. To finally think I can successfully create an Uber account on the app, I was terribly wrong. After reading the terms and conditions and policies, which to add takes a very long time, was instructions state, so clicked the arrow below confirming that I agree with the terms&conditions etc. to find that it’s won’t even load onto the next stage of signing up. So in total it had taken me 11 days to not even fully be able to create and access an Uber riding account. I fully believe I have wasted time in trying and is not worth all of the hassle.

I was involved in an incident where I felt I had to leave the car before the journey started. As soon as I left the car I realised my bag was still inside. I went to open the car and the driver began to drive away. I said “I’ve left my bag” but the driver (having clearly heard this) continued to drive. I sprinted after the car for at least 100 metres in slow traffic. For the most part being right next to the driver. Shouting at the top of my voice “my bag” he just looked at me and drove away. At 4 am I was stranded with no wallet or house keys. I called Uber and after 2 hours of being on hold or cut off. Been a user for quite a long time now and every single time I take a ride, no matter the time of day or the country where I use the service, there is an issue and I end up being charged more. If the App looks great and is easy to use, if the concept is great and the prices perfect (for usage in London mostly, even when prices are bumped up in high demand times), the App uses a lot of battery (I run an iPhone, with a new battery) when searching for a driver and it is not uncommon to have the drivers cancelling. Secondly the pre booking functions is gone, probably driven by the above change in job-distribution, significantly restrict the functionality of Uber's services.

Lastly, I no longer receive a notifications once the driver has arrived, making the 2 minutes waiting time a laugh (I still receive the first connection notification, confirmation of estimated arrival time, sometime (!) the 2 minute warning until arriving but no longer the "your driver has arrived" notification) - please fix this or people will almost certainly consider other services!

Uber is undeniably a convenient tool for finding a taxi quickly. The app is well-designed, easy to navigate, and offers the flexibility of multiple payment options, which enhances the user experience significantly. Whether you’re in a hurry or just want to avoid the hassle of hailing a cab on the street, Uber consistently delivers with its reliable and fast service.

However, one significant downside I've encountered is the pricing discrepancy when using Uber abroad. Recently, while trying to book a ride in Poland, I was quoted 56 PLN for a journey. Surprisingly, my friend, who used a local Polish Uber account for the same trip at the same time, was quoted only 31 PLN. This nearly 80% premium for using a non-domestic Uber account feels excessive and unfair, especially when the service provided is identical. 

While I appreciate Uber’s overall efficiency and ease of use, this substantial price difference when traveling is disappointing and something potential users should be aware of when relying on the app outside their home country.

I needed to book a train for 4 people from Reading to London at the weekend. The Uber App offered a Groupsave return ticket option but it didn’t offer a London Travelcard Groupsave option. The Travelcard option includes return train and Tube travel in London. Groupsave is a discount that is applied to group bookings. The cheaper Groupsave Travelcard fare was available on the Trainline and GWR apps. 

When booking a train on the Uber app I would recommend checking the fare options against another app (e.g Trainline) before committing to a fare in the Uber app.

This results in wildly inaccurate charges as the vehicle track that comes through with the receipt shows you made a sudden jump to somewhere several miles away from where you actually travelled, went round in bizarrely shaped circles etc.

After a bit of back and forth with Uber customer services they’ll manually adjust this to remove the excess “distance” you get charged, but really it shouldn’t be happening in the first place - but as of 2018 this glitch still exists in the pricing algorithm.

Advance booking isn’t really advance booking. They just call a cab for you at a certain time and hope there’s one available. For that reason you can’t book for a particular time and they provide a 15min window. If you are going to the airport then 15mins makes a difference therefore you book 5mins earlier than you need it. Time comes up, you are getting all your bags together, saying goodbye, putting the cat in. The driver calls at the time that you wanted him for as it took time to find the cab and for him to arrive, you ask him to wait while you get in the lift to meet the cab and Uber cancels as it has been 8mins after the start of the window (even though it’s been 3mins after the driver arrived) and you get a £6 charge. This is crazy. 

A) Advance bookings should be that - you book a driver in advance. 
B) If a driver doesn’t turn up then they should be charged and a local substitute take it’s place.
C) Arrival should be a particular time 
D) If Uber has a 15min window then you should also have 15mins
E) the clock should start as soon as the driver arrives so they don’t lose out.

Save the hassle, if you are going to the airport then book a regular cab the night before to meet you at a particular time. It’s the same cost and so much easier.

If they can’t get this right then the business will never expand outside of city centres. Am going to look at other apps.

I’ve used this app and Uber several times in Glasgow, Birmingham, Sheffield and Bristol; as well as Boston, Chicago and Houston in the USA and in Mexico City and Sweden.

The app has worked faultlessly, though I need the ensure I have WiFi when initiating a trip since I don’t always have a roaming facility in foreign places. I always specify exactly where I am for pick up as well as whatever the map thinks.

In Mexico it was great to have a more-or-less known, fixed fare rather than have negotiations and uncertainty about the fairness of the fare.

Most estimates of arrival times seemed fair, some took a little longer, and no one came early. I found the map showing their progress very useful.

The only real issue was the lack of service in areas outside major cities. I found Glasgow OK for the central area and airport, but not so much for the outer suburbs.

It also seems that the range of fare charges was “wide”, like £9-13; I suppose reflects traffic conditions. But it might help if that upper limit could be a cap on the costs.

All in all a useful app and reliable service.

- when I’ve had issues with drivers not turning up (at all) they charge a £6 cancellation fee - even after calling them several times on the phone and they don’t pick up.
